3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 65-year-old male received Dose 1 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 23 May 2026. Approximately 13 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Myocarditis. The patient sought medical attention and was managed outpatient. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter cannot exclude a relationship with mRNA-1273 vaccination.
